trainer_scp.name: Professor Oak
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Professor Oak is not to be contained forcibly. Interaction requires Level-3 clearance. Personnel must avoid providing unrestricted access to anomalous specimens.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T001 is a senior biological researcher with anomalous cognitive abilities allowing rapid classification and behavioral prediction of anomalous creatures. SCP-T001’s research output exceeds normal human capacity.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Calm, analytical, and cooperative. Displays paternal behavior toward younger parahumans.
addendum_logs: Addendum T001-A: SCP-T001 identified behavioral anomalies in SCP-0004 (Charmander) before sensors detected them.
Addendum T001-B: SCP-T001 claims to have 'felt' SCP-0151 (Mew) before visual confirmation.

trainer_scp.name: Ash Ketchum
abilities: rapid trust formation with hostile anomalies
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T002 is not to be contained unless compromised. Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T002 to high-threat anomalies without supervision.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T002 is a juvenile parahuman exhibiting anomalous affinity toward dangerous SCP creatures. SCP-T002 forms emotional bonds with entities typically hostile to humans, reducing aggression levels.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Optimistic, impulsive, and highly resilient. Displays extreme loyalty toward bonded anomalies.
addendum_logs: Addendum T002-A: SCP-T002 calmed SCP-0059 (Arcanine) during a rage event without protective gear.
Addendum T002-B: SCP-T002 survived a lightning strike from SCP-0145 (Zapdos) with minor injuries.

trainer_scp.name: Gary Oak
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T003 requires psychological monitoring during competitive events. Personnel must avoid provoking SCP-T003’s ego-driven behavior.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T003 exhibits heightened cognitive performance and competitive aggression. Displays anomalous influence over certain SCP creatures, increasing their combat efficiency.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Confident, prideful, and occasionally confrontational. Responds strongly to perceived rivalry.
addendum_logs: Addendum T003-A: SCP-T003’s presence increased SCP-0034 (Nidoking)’s aggression output by 18%.
Addendum T003-B: SCP-T003 solved a complex containment puzzle in under 40 seconds.

trainer_scp.name: Brock
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: No containment required. SCP-T004 may assist in geological anomaly containment.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T004 is a parahuman with anomalous physical resilience and deep understanding of mineral-based SCP entities. Frequently assists in containment of SCP-0076 (Golem) and related anomalies.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Calm, disciplined, and protective. Displays strong leadership traits.
addendum_logs: Addendum T004-A: SCP-T004 endured a direct impact from SCP-0074 (Geodude) with no injury.
Addendum T004-B: SCP-T004 identified structural weaknesses in SCP-0075 (Graveler)’s shell.

trainer_scp.name: Misty
abilities: rapid adaptation to water pressure changes
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T005 is not to be contained. Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T005 to high-threat aquatic anomalies without escort.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T005 displays anomalous resistance to hydrokinesis-based attacks and can operate efficiently in aquatic environments. Frequently interacts with SCP-0131 (Lapras) and SCP-0055 (Golduck).
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Confident, assertive, and emotionally reactive. Displays strong protective instincts.
addendum_logs: Addendum T005-A: SCP-T005 resisted SCP-0055’s hydrokinesis blast with minimal displacement.
Addendum T005-B: SCP-T005 navigated a flooded containment wing without equipment.

trainer_scp.name: Lt. Surge
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid direct contact during electrical surges. SCP-T006 must not be allowed near SCP-0125 (Electabuzz) or SCP-0101 (Electrode) during instability.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T006 is a parahuman capable of conducting and redirecting electrical energy. Displays anomalous synergy with electric-type SCP entities, increasing their output.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive, confident, and militaristic. Displays thrill-seeking behavior during electrical storms.
addendum_logs: Addendum T006-A: SCP-T006 absorbed a 40,000-volt discharge with minor burns.
Addendum T006-B: Electrical output of SCP-0135 (Jolteon) increased by 27% in SCP-T006’s presence.

trainer_scp.name: Erika
abilities: anomalous calming influence on plant anomalies
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T007 may assist in containment of plant-based anomalies. Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T007 to SCP-0045 (Vileplume) without respirators.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T007 displays empathic influence over botanical SCP entities, reducing aggression and accelerating growth. Shows mild resistance to airborne toxins.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Calm, gentle, and introspective. Prefers quiet environments.
addendum_logs: Addendum T007-A: SCP-T007 neutralized SCP-0044’s toxic emissions through sustained contact.
Addendum T007-B: SCP-0043 (Oddish) displayed unusual attachment to SCP-T007.

trainer_scp.name: Koga
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid inhaling airborne compounds near SCP-T008. SCP-T008 must not be allowed near SCP-0089 (Muk) without containment gear.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T008 is a parahuman with anomalous resistance to toxins and limited ability to manipulate airborne compounds. Displays stealth capabilities beyond normal human limits.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Calm, disciplined, and secretive. Shows preference for low-light environments.
addendum_logs: Addendum T008-A: SCP-T008 traversed a toxin-filled chamber without protective gear.
Addendum T008-B: Airborne toxin density decreased in SCP-T008’s presence.

trainer_scp.name: Sabrina
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T009 cannot be reliably contained. Personnel must maintain cognitive shielding during interaction.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T009 is a high-level psychic parahuman capable of telepathic communication, telekinetic force, and limited precognition. Displays power levels approaching SCP-0065 (Alakazam).
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Detached, calm, and enigmatic. Displays minimal emotional expression.
addendum_logs: Addendum T009-A: SCP-T009 suppressed SCP-0064 (Kadabra)’s psychic output effortlessly.
Addendum T009-B: SCP-T009 predicted a containment breach 14 minutes before sensors detected it.

trainer_scp.name: Blaine
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid proximity during thermal surges. SCP-T010 must not be allowed near SCP-0146 (Moltres) under any circumstances.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T010 displays anomalous resistance to high temperatures and limited pyrokinesis. Frequently collaborates with fire-type anomalies, amplifying their output.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Intense, eccentric, and unpredictable. Displays fascination with volcanic environments.
addendum_logs: Addendum T010-A: SCP-T010 walked through a 600°C chamber unharmed.
Addendum T010-B: SCP-0126 (Magmar)’s flame output increased by 32% in SCP-T010’s presence.
